description: Current Dutch amounts that change every year, each with the period it applies to and its official source, so an answer does not rely on outdated knowledge. Topics: health_deductible (Healthcare deductible (eigen risico)), child_benefit (Child benefit (kinderbijslag)), passport_id_fees (Passport and identity card fees), ind_fees (IND application fees (residence permits and naturalisation)), rent_limits (Rent limits and maximum rent increases), minimum_wage (Minimum wage (wettelijk minimumloon)). Ask by topic, or with a short question. For income tax figures use the tax server's dutch_tax_figures tool.
